hypothesis_additions.claim: The later XRP and RLUSD transfers from rDAE53... to rs8ZPb... represent Binance's internal recovery/consolidation after the theft.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: On-chain signatures do not identify the human/operator controlling the hot wallet; a compromised source wallet could theoretically send to a Binance-labelled destination. Bithomp labels are third-party attribution, not proof of authorization.

hypothesis_additions.claim: The actor who drained XRP could have retained access to rDAE53... and initiated later transfers, even if the destination was a Binance-labelled reserve wallet.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Both later destinations are the same old Binance-labelled reserve wallet; the XRP and RLUSD transfers were successful and the destination received dust from other Binance-labelled hot wallets.

hypothesis_additions.claim: The 40.5M RLUSD freeze reported by Ripple occurred on Ethereum; it does not imply the 51.172508M RLUSD on XRPL was frozen. The XRPL transfer was a successful payment.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: No independent complete issuer-account transaction audit for the entire Oct25-30 XRPL window was performed; the no-freeze assertion remains secondary.
